task.title: Set up your profile
task.shortdesc: Create the card people nearby see when they open your profile. Setup takes two screens, asks for no permissions, and keeps everything on your phone.

taskbody.prereq: You must be 18 or over to use .

step.info: Used on another phone? Tap I already have a profile instead. See .

step.cmd: On About you, enter your First name.
Enter your Date of birth in the Day, Month, and Year fields.
step.info: People see your age, never your birthday. You can't change your date of birth later.

step.cmd: Add a photo and One line about you.
step.info: Under Photo (optional), choose Take a photo or Choose from library. Your line can be up to 120 characters. People nearby who see your card can see your photo; you can change who sees it later.

step.cmd: On What are you into?, pick 3 to 10 interests.
step.info: People nearby who share them show up first. Under Add your own you can add up to 5 words of your own, 30 characters each. They only match someone who typed the same words.

result.p: opens on the Nearby tab, and your 12 recovery words are created in the background.
result.note: A new profile starts with Show my age on, your photo visible to Everyone nearby, and anyone able to say hi. To change these, see .

taskbody.tasktroubleshooting: If you see OMNI is for adults, the date of birth you entered is under 18, and can't be used on this phone.
